ValidationRule.description: QAC Website cases cannot be edited by Support team
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( RecordType.Name == 'Service Request' , Created_From_Website__c == 'QAC',
OR( ISCHANGED(Origin ), ISCHANGED(Subject), ISCHANGED(Description) , ISCHANGED(Additional_Requirements__c), ISCHANGED( AccountId ), ISCHANGED( Problem_Type__c ), ISCHANGED(Waiver_Sub_Type__c), ISCHANGED( Passenger_Name__c ), AND(ISCHANGED(PNR_number__c ), NOT(ISBLANK(PRIORVALUE(PNR_number__c)))) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Waiver Type, Waiver Sub Type, Account Name, Origin, Subject, Description, Additional Requirements, PNR Number, Passenger Name and fields cannot be modified for QAC Website cases.
